// CASE ts_outer_loop_inner_awaited_iterable expect=fire
export async function total(companies: string[], store: Store) {
	let sum = 0;
	for (const company of companies) {
		for (const row of await store.listRows(company)) {
			sum += row.amount;
		}
	}
	return sum;
}
// CASE ts_single_loop_awaited_iterable expect=pass
export async function single(store: Store) {
	let sum = 0;
	for (const row of await store.listRows("a")) {
		sum += row.amount;
	}
	return sum;
}
